reserveReview.rationale: The eleven categories reproduce the dollar amounts in the June 30, 2026 report, signed July 31, 2026. Percentages are derived from the report's total assets and rounded to six decimals. Both authored composition arrays use this same dated allocation. The live transparency endpoint supplies a separate balance-sheet observation and does not refresh composition. The issuer webpage displays assets of USD 187751825408, liabilities of USD 183642296213 and equity of USD 4109529195; the signed PDF gives USD 187751426411, USD 183641897215 and USD 4109529196, respectively. The USD 398997 asset discrepancy has no verified explanation or issuer reconciliation in the inspected sources; this composition uses the internally reconciling signed PDF denominator. The report covers fiat-denominated Tether tokens, not an independently allocated USDT-only balance sheet. Verified confidence covers the sourced amounts and date, not unresolved look-through identities. The new non-US sovereign and corporate legacy risk tiers are conservative editorial classifications, not attested ratings. Weighted-average maturities do not establish hard maturity maxima; only the expressly stated overnight repo maturity retains a one-day maximum.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: BDO-assured Tether International reserves for fiat-denominated tokens at 2026-06-30 23:59 UTC; eleven reported USD asset categories divided by total assets of USD 187751426411.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The selected unresolved look-through set comprises non-US Treasury bills, corporate bonds, public equities, other investments and secured loans: the report does not identify their sovereign or corporate issuers, borrowers, positions or concentration. Its USD 22491186153 aggregate is 11.979236% of reported total assets when rounded to six decimals; the individually rounded slice percentages sum to 11.979235%. This set is not all counterparty uncertainty; banking and repo counterparties also remain unnamed.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The Q1 2026 BDO report identifies reserve asset categories only in aggregate and names no custodians (BDO obtained confirmations directly from unnamed banks and depositaries). The CNAD-filed Relevant Information Document (2026-02-20) states reserves are held with various unidentified third parties including banks and licensed financial institutions, and documents no trust, SPV, segregation vehicle, bankruptcy-remoteness, or reuse restrictions; the Terms grant holders only a personal contractual redemption right. Custodian names, provider shares, legal segregation, and reuse restrictions remain undisclosed in every available primary source.
